dag_infos.description: New Taipei City population recorded through initial household registration by single year of age, sex, origin category and district, from MOI Household Registration open data ODRP072. Village-level source rows are aggregated to district level; single-year age makes 18-35 exact.

data_infos.name_cn: 新北市歸化及定居取得國籍人口（單齡年齡、來源、性別、行政區）
data_infos.source_type: 內政部戶政司 RIS OpenData API (ODRP072)
data_infos.dataset_description: ODRP072 是初設戶籍／歸化及定居取得國籍人口的年度村里級資料，欄位含來源類別、性別與單齡年齡。本DAG逐頁抓取後只保留新北市29個行政區，再由村里聚合到行政區；不把它描述成一般遷入人口。已驗證民國112至113年。單齡年齡使18-35可exact取得。
data_infos.etl_description: Discover annual ROC periods around anchor ROC 113, stopping in each direction after two consecutive years with no RIS data. Fetch every page with COUNTY=新北市 and a browser User-Agent. RIS no-data is HTTP 200 with responseCode OD-0102-S, so responseCode is authoritative. Filter by the first eight digits of district_code while each page is in hand; non-New-Taipei rows are never accumulated. Parse age labels into integer bounds, map male/female, validate all six observed origin categories, aggregate village records to district and city rows, and reconcile the input count to both district and city output on every period. A three-times-other-year-median scale guard fails unknown scope changes; KNOWN_BAD_YEARS is empty. This source represents initial household registration / naturalization and settlement nationality acquisition, not ordinary migration.
